title: Scope
text: Display signals generated during simulation, 1 input, no direct feedthrough, {Style} sets Line style; {Open at simulation start} sets when scope opens, {Display the full path} displays block path on scope title bar, {Number of input ports}, {Display grid} sets the dimensions of display grid, {Input processing} sets the sample- or frame-based processing Elements, {Maximize axes} sets the maximize size of plots, {Sample time} sets the simulation interval between scope updates, {Time span} sets the length of x -axis to display, {Overrun action} displays data beyond visible x, {Time units} sets the x -axis units, {Time display offset} sets the x -axis offset, {T-axis and ticks labels} displays of x -axis, {Time offset view} shows time offset on status bar, {Show time-axis label} displays or hide x -axis labels, {Scale Y-axis limits} sets the y -axis scaling, {Y-axis limits do not shrink} allows y -axis range limits to increase, {Number of updates}, {Scale Y-axis limits at stop} scales y -axis limits when simulation stops, {Y-axis data range (%)} sets the percent of y -axis to use for plotting, {Y-axis align} sets the alignment along y, {Scale X-axis limits} scales x -axis range limits, {X-axis data range (%)} sets the percent of x -axis to use for plotting, {X-axis align} sets the alignment along x, {Limit data points to last} limits buffered data points or frames, {Max points} sets the maximum number of data points to save, {Decimation} sets the reduce amount of scope data to display, {Decimation value}, {Log data to workspace} sets the save data to MATLAB workspace, {Variable name} sets the name of saved data, {Save format} sets the mATLAB variable format, {Plot type} sets the type of plot, {Axes background} sets the background color for individual displays, {Axes and grid} sets the axes, grid, and label color for individual displays, {Scope background} sets the background color for scope, {Preserve colors for copy} sets the preserve colors when copying scope, {Active Display}, {Line}, {Width} sets the line width, {Marker} sets the data point marker style, {Color} sets the line color, {Line visible} sets the line visibility, {Y-axis label}, {Y-axis limits}, {Title} displays name, {Show legend} displays signal legend, {Show grid} shows internal grid lines, {Plot as magnitude-phase} sets the split display into magnitude and phase, {Display Grid} displays layout 1-by-1, {Dock}, {Undock} and {Dock New Scopes on Open} adds new scopes to the container on open. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Port_1
ports.summary: Signal or signals to visualize scalar | vector | matrix | array | bus | nonvirtual bus

params.name: Open at simulation start
params.values: Specify when scope opens off (default for Scope) | on (default for Time Scope)

params.name: Display the full path
params.values: Display block path on scope title bar off (default) | on

params.name: Number of input ports
params.values: Number of input ports on scope 1 (default) | positive integer in the range [1 96]

params.name: Display grid
params.values: Dimensions of display grid [1, 1] (default) | two-element numeric vector

params.name: Input processing
params.values: Sample- or frame-based processing Elements as channels (sample based) (default for Scope) | Columns as channels (frame based) (default for Time Scope)

params.name: Maximize axes
params.values: Maximize size of plots Off (default for Scope) | Auto (default for Time Scope) | On

params.name: Sample time
params.values: Simulation interval between scope updates -1 (for inherited) (default) | positive real number

params.name: Time span
params.values: Length of x -axis to display Auto (default) | One frame period |

params.name: Overrun action
params.values: Display data beyond visible x -axis Wrap (default) | Scroll

params.name: Time units
params.values: x -axis units None (default for Scope) | Metric (based on Time Span) (default for Time Scope) | Seconds

params.name: Time display offset
params.values: x -axis offset 0 (default) | scalar | vector

params.name: T-axis and ticks labels
params.values: Display of x -axis (time) and tick labels Bottom displays only (default for Scope) | All (default for Time Scope) | None

params.name: Time offset view
params.values: Show time offset on status bar on (default) | off

params.name: Show time-axis label
params.values: Display or hide x -axis labels off (default for Scope) | on (default for Time Scope)

params.name: Scale Y-axis limits
params.values: y -axis scaling mode Manual (default) | Auto | After N Updates

params.name: Y-axis limits do not shrink
params.values: Allow y -axis range limits to increase on (default) | off

params.name: Number of updates

params.name: Scale Y-axis limits at stop
params.values: Scale y -axis limits when simulation stops on (default) | off

params.name: Y-axis data range (%)
params.values: Percent of y -axis to use for plotting 80 (default) | integer between [1,100]

params.name: Y-axis align
params.values: Alignment along y -axis Center (default) | Top | Bottom

params.name: Scale X-axis limits
params.values: Scale x -axis range limits off (default) | on

params.name: X-axis data range (%)
params.values: Percent of x -axis to use for plotting 100 (default) | integer in the range [1,100]

params.name: X-axis align
params.values: Alignment along x -axis Center (default) | Left | Right

params.name: Limit data points to last
